ERC20 balance mapping address=>uint256.

GlobalsStore struct holding lockedSunsTotal, shareRate, dailyDataCount and latestStakeId.
Mapping day => DailyDataStore (payout total, dividends, stake shares).
Mapping address => StakeStore[] of active stakes per user.
Mapping address => UnstakeStore[] history of closed stakes.
Mapping day => total ETH entered into the auction lobby, the funding source for dividends and lottery prizes.

Cursor of the dev-share flush loop over past days.
Accumulator of lottery funds for days without participants, rolled into the next winning day.
Private monotonically increasing counter mixed into the pseudo-random seed.
Boolean guard preventing a second ownerClaimFirstTwoDays() payout.
Fallback referrer address receiving the referral bonus when no valid referrer is supplied.
Day number of the first auction entry; drives onlyAfterNDays guards and flush/claim logic.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, stake ownership, payouts and random seed.
Block timestamp used for day calculation, lottery entry windows and the random seed.
Context._msgSender(): returns msg.sender as execution context.
Ownable.isOwner(): compares _msgSender() with _owner.
Ownable.transferOwnership/_transferOwnership: reassigns _owner, onlyOwner guarded.
Sets _owner to address(0), permanently disabling onlyOwner functions.
ERC20.transfer(): moves tokens from _msgSender() to recipient.
Internal balance transfer between two accounts using SafeMath.
ERC20.transferFrom(): transfers from sender and decrements the caller allowance.
ERC20.approve(): sets an allowance via _approve.
Internal allowance writer with zero-address checks.
Internal mint: increases _totalSupply and the recipient balance.
Internal burn: decreases balance and _totalSupply.
External maintenance call that advances dailyData for a bounded day range.
Computes the current day as (block.timestamp - LAUNCH_TIME) / ROUND_TIME.
External entry to open a stake; burns staker tokens and enforces MIN_STAKE_DAYS.
External permissionless call that unlocks any staker's served stake and records the penalty.
External stake closure: computes payout/dividends, sends ETH to msg.sender, mints the stake return.
Public lottery settlement loop that draws winners with _random and assigns lobby funds.
Public claim of accrued lottery winnings via transfer to the stored winner address.
Private pseudo-random generator seeded with block fields, msg.sender and nonce.
Payable auction entry that records lobby funds and allocates lottery tickets.
Auction exit loop computing per-entry xf amounts and minting rewards/referral bonuses.
onlyOwner dev-share release over past days via flushAddr.transfer.
onlyOwner one-shot claim of the first two auction days via flushAddr.transfer.
Deployment initializer: sets timings, share rate, referrer/flush addresses and sends the whole supply to the flush address.
Internal stake creation computing bonus shares and the locked day.
Pure LPB/BPB stake bonus calculation.
Computes stakeReturn, payout, dividends and capped penalty for a served stake.
Early-unstake payout and penalty calculation.
Late-unlock penalty scaled by days past the grace period.
Raises the global share rate after a profitable stake end.
Public view computing reward payout for a day range with weekly bonus scaling.
Public view computing the staker's 90% share of daily dividends.
Removes stake shares from the total and stamps the unlocked day.
Tracks which lottery day is awaiting a winner.
Pure decay function giving the claim amount per lobby day.
Pure weekday computation (dayNumberBegin + day) % 7.
Public view previewing unstake results for an arbitrary user address.
Private event emitter for lobby exits.
Private day-by-day accounting loop updating dailyData and emitting DailyDataUpdate.
Pure daily inflation payout calculation allocSupply * 342345 / 685188967.
msg.sender.transfer(dividends) inside stakeEnd: ETH sent to an untrusted caller during stake settlement.
winners[day].who.transfer(restAmount): ETH payout to a stored winner address before the amount is reset.
flushAddr.transfer(...) inside an unbounded while loop in xfFlush.
flushAddr.transfer(xfLobby[firstAuction] + xfLobby[firstAuction+1]) draining the first two auction days.
Constructor calls transfer() sending the entire supply to a hardcoded flush address.
keccak256(now, msg.sender, nonce, blockhash, block.number, coinbase, difficulty) % limit: predictable on-chain randomness used for lottery selection.
_mint of computed xf amounts plus 10% referral bonuses to default/real referrers with no supply cap.
winners[lastEndedLoteryDay] record created and prize funds assigned inside endLoteryDay before any claim.
Attacker-controlled number of Suns burned to open a stake.
Attacker-controlled stake duration, bounds-checked to [MIN_STAKE_DAYS, MAX_STAKE_DAYS].
Arbitrary staker address supplied to stakeGoodAccounting().
Index into a stake list, validated against the list length.
Expected stake id used to reject stale indexes.
Optional referrer supplied to xfLobbyEnter and stored per queue entry.
Lobby day selected by the caller for enter/exit.
Number of queued entries to exit in xfLobbyExit.
Requested last day to settle in endLoteryDay, or day to claim in withdrawLotery.
Upper bound day for dailyDataUpdate, clamped to the current day.
Destination address of an ERC20 transfer.
Token amount argument used in transfer/approve/transferFrom.
Allowance grantee in approve().
New owner address passed to transferOwnership().
Mint/burn target account.
User address queried by getUnstakeParams().
Modulus limit for _random, derived from dayChanceCount.

Snapshot of globals used to decide which fields need writing back.
StakeCache memory copy of a StakeStore entry.
msg.value of a lobby entry, cast to uint96.
Accumulated xf amount minted to the exiting member.
Days actually served by a stake, clamped to stakedDays.
Suns returned to the staker after penalties.
Reward payout in Suns.
Penalty amount, capped at the stake return.
Lottery draw result from _random(ChanceCount).
Lottery prize amount (25/1000 of the day lobby plus carried undistributed funds).
Shares minted for a new stake including bonuses.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by _msgSender() as the execution context.
isOwner compares caller identity against _owner for authorisation.
stakeStart burns the staked Suns from the caller.
stakeEnd pays the caller and mints the stake return to msg.sender.
xfLobbyEnter keys the lobby queue and ticket list by the caller.
xfLobbyExit mints accumulated xf amount to _msgSender().
msg.sender is mixed into the pseudo-random seed.
Current day is derived directly from block.timestamp.
block.timestamp is part of the random seed.
now % ROUND_TIME <= LOTERY_ENTRY_TIME gates the lottery entry window.
Entry eligibility in xfLobbyEnter depends on block.timestamp modulo ROUND_TIME.
Constructor initialises day counters from block.timestamp versus LAUNCH_TIME.
DailyDataUpdate event timestamp is block.timestamp.
stakeEnd uses the current day to derive servedDays.
endLoteryDay clamps settlement to currDay - 1.
xfLobbyEnter uses the current day as the lobby day.
xfLobbyExit enforces enterDay < currDay.
GlobalsStore fields loaded into the GlobalsCache memory struct.
StakeStore entry copied into the StakeCache memory struct.
Stake size parameter feeds burn and share arithmetic.
Stake duration parameter feeds bonus share arithmetic.
Index parameter is used in list length arithmetic and removal.
Stake id is validated inside _stakeLoad against the stored stakeId.
Arbitrary stakerAddr lets any caller unlock another user's stake.
Referrer address is stored in the queue entry for later bonus payout.
enterDay selects which lobby queue is drained.
count bounds the exit loop and index arithmetic.
endDay drives the settlement while loop.
beforeDay limits the daily update range.
recipient is the destination of an ERC20 transfer.
amount is the value moved in an ERC20 transfer.
spender is the allowance grantee in approve.
newOwner is assigned to the privileged _owner slot.
account is the mint target.
user address selects whose stake list is previewed.
limit is the modulus applied to the random draw.
Random draw result determines the winner ticket index.
Prize amount is computed as 25/1000 of the day lobby plus carry-over.
nonce is read into the random seed and incremented.
undestributedLotery is added to the next prize and then zeroed.
stakeStart delegates stake creation to _stakeStart.
stakeStart burns the staked Suns via _burn.
stakeStart settles the previous lottery day.
stakeGoodAccounting settles the previous lottery day.
stakeEnd computes stake performance.
stakeEnd sends ETH dividends to msg.sender before final state sync.
stakeEnd mints the stake return to the staker.
stakeEnd updates the global share rate.
Short stakes take the early penalty payout path.
Full-term stakes take the late penalty path.
Payout is computed through calcPayoutRewards.
Dividends are computed through calcPayoutDividendsReward.
Early penalty path calls calcPayoutRewards for penalty and delta ranges.
Early penalty path also computes dividends.
Stake creation adds bonus Suns from _stakeStartBonusSuns.
Share rate update recomputes bonus Suns for the new rate.
endLoteryDay draws the winner index with _random.
endLoteryDay writes the winners record and assigns prize funds.
The weak randomness computation is performed inside _random.
xfLobbyEnter settles the previous lottery day.
xfLobbyExit settles lottery days before draining the queue.
xfLobbyExit mints xf amounts and referral bonuses.
Ticket registration updates the waiting-for-winner day.
withdrawLotery transfers ETH to the winner address.
xfFlush transfers the dev share inside an unbounded loop.
ownerClaimFirstTwoDays transfers the first two auction days to flushAddr.
Jackpot constructor transfers the whole supply.
dailyDataUpdate runs the private update loop.
The update loop calls the pure daily round calculator.
isOwner reads _owner for authorisation decisions.
transferOwnership writes the privileged _owner slot.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
Balance subtraction and addition performed with SafeMath.
Mint increases the recipient balance.
Burn decreases the holder balance.
Allowance slot written by _approve.
Mint increases _totalSupply.
Burn decreases _totalSupply.
getUnstakeParams reuses _stakePerformance for previews.
Winner record written for the settled day.
Ticket list read to select the winning entry.
Chance count read to size the random draw.
msg.value added into xfLobby[enterDay].
Entry appended to the caller's lobby queue.
Lottery tickets registered for the sender when eligibility holds.
Queue head advanced after processing entries.
Lobby total used to pro-rate the exit amount.
Flush cursor incremented each loop iteration.
One-shot claim guard set after the transfer.
First auction day read to size the claim.
flushAddr hardcoded and also made the contract owner at deployment.
defaultReferrerAddr hardcoded in the constructor.
globals.shareRate initialised to SHARE_RATE_SCALE.
nonce incremented after each random draw.
Value transfer to msg.sender occurs before the final _globalsSync, allowing re-entrant stakeEnd/stakeStart calls.
Transfer to the winner fires before restAmount is zeroed, enabling repeated withdrawLotery claims.
Transfer executes inside the unbounded while loop of xfFlush.
flushAddr transfer happens before isFirstTwoDaysWithdrawed is set, enabling re-entrant claim attempts.
Predictable block data lets the caller bias the draw reachable through endLoteryDay.
Mint call inside the exit loop re-enters ERC20 supply accounting.
Constructor's transfer re-enters the ERC20 transfer implementation.
